tasks.task: Install the frozen wheel in a fresh environment and obtain an offline readiness result.
tasks.success: Installed wheel/version matches build identity; offline doctor result is understood. Preinstalled environments do not count as installation success.

tasks.task: Inspect the assigned local synthetic capture through guided session intake and identify its source, instrument, multiplier, time range and assumptions.
tasks.success: Integrity and source identity match the fixture answer key; synthetic provenance and model assumptions remain visible. Integrity does not grant capture rights.

tasks.task: Choose the final event checkpoint, open it in Wind Tunnel, explain one structural level and one quality or model limitation.
tasks.success: Selected capture prefix and as_of match the answer key; level/model/units match the saved receipt. Missing source evidence or fallback assumptions are named without inventing coverage.

tasks.task: Inspect separate position models and change one scenario parameter.
tasks.success: OI, raw volume and directionalized volume stay separate. Unavailable views remain unavailable; the participant explains the changed input and keeps the source checkpoint fixed.

tasks.task: Save and export a scenario receipt, then reproduce it in a fresh Wind Tunnel server with an empty workspace.
tasks.success: Fresh-server reproduction verifies the receipt without the original uploaded capture or source server. The source cutoff and original scenario inputs are retained.

tasks.task: Open the assigned bundled replay in Terminal, freeze it with w into Wind Tunnel and explain what the offline result establishes.
tasks.success: Terminal checkpoint identity, assumptions and selected model are visible. Participant states that offline success establishes neither live-provider reliability nor predictive value.

limits: A prepared kit and automated rehearsal are not participant observations. Retain all assistance, failures, refusals and not-started attempts.
